40014427.author: पदार्थः
40014427.content: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.

40014427.author: Translation
40014427.content: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

40014429.author: Translation
40014429.content: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

40014430.author: पदार्थः
40014430.content: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.

40014430.content: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

40014430.author: सारांशः
40014430.content: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.

40014431.author: पदार्थः
40014431.content: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.

40014431.author: Translation
40014431.content: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

40014431.author: सारांशः
40014431.content: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.

40014432.author: पदार्थः
40014432.content: रामम् Rama, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva, येन: on which account, लङ्का: Lanka, प्रधर्षिता: was attacked, कृपणम् vile, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अद्य: now, वधिष्यामः will kill.

40014432.author: Translation
40014432.content: "Right now, we will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, Sugriva and vile Hanuman, on whose account Lanka was attacked."

40014433.author: पदार्थः
40014433.content: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, गृहीतायुधान् wielding arms, तान् सर्वान् all those, वारयित्वा: stopping, तान् those, प्रत्युपवेश्य: and making them sit, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् addressed.

40014433.author: Translation
40014433.content: With folded hands, Vibheeshana made all the (Rakshasas) wielding arms to stop and sit and addressed these words to Ravana.

40014434.author: पदार्थः
40014434.content: तात: father, यः one who takes, अर्थः I ask, त्रिभिः of the three (Sama, Dana and Bheda), उपायैरपि: means also, प्राप्तम् attained, नशक्यते: not possible, तस्य: his, विक्रमकालान् heroic deed, युक्तान् diligently, मनीषिणः intelligent, आहुः yes.

40014434.author: Translation
40014434.content: "Dear father, intelligent people say that an act which cannot be accomplished by the three means (Sama  Conciliation, Dana  Gift, Bheda  Sowing dissension), should only be accomplished diligently by one's heroic deed. Therefore, we should think of war only after the above three means are employed."

40014435.author: पदार्थः
40014435.content: तात: father, प्रमत्तेषु: at those who are not alert, अभियुक्तेषु: at those who are attacked, दैवेन: by fate, प्रहतेषुच: those who are struck, परीक्ष्य: examine, विधिना: according to prescribed method, कृताः one who performed deeds, विक्रमाः of heroic valour, सिध्यन्ति: will succeed.

40014435.author: Translation
40014435.content: "O Dear at those who are not alert, who are attacked by the enemy, and who are struck by fate, if you examine diligently according to prescribed method and perform deeds of heroic valour you will succeed."

40014436.author: पदार्थः
40014436.content: अप्रमत्तम् very attentive, विजिगीषुम् bent on victory, बले: mighty, स्थितम् steadfast, जितरोषम् subdued anger, दुराधर्षम् unassailable, तम् him, कथम् how, प्रधर्षयितुम् to overpower, इच्छथ: desire.

40014436.author: Translation
40014436.content: "How do you wish to overpower, him who is very attentive, bent on victory, mighty, steadfast, has subdued anger and unassailable?"

40014437.author: पदार्थः
40014437.content: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of streams and rivers, घोरम् terrific, समुद्रम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा: crossed over, हनुमतः Hanuman, गतिम् arrived at, लोके: in the world, कः who can ever, विद्यात् can know, तर्कयेतवा: or think of.

40014437.author: Translation
40014437.content: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"

40014438.author: पदार्थः
40014438.content: निशाचराः night ranger, परेषाम् enemy's, बलानि: strength, वीर्याणिच: and valour, अपरिमेयानि: inestimable, कथञ्चन: to relate, सहसा: rashly, अवज्ञा: to disregard, नकर्तव्या: not do.

40014438.author: Translation
40014438.content: "Enemy's strength and valour is inestimable to relate. Do not disregard rashly, O Night ranger"

40014439.author: पदार्थः
40014439.content: यशस्विनः glorious, यस्य: his, भार्याम् wife, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, आजहार: abducted, रामेण: Rama's, पुरा: earlier, राक्षसराजस्य: to the Rakshasa king, किम् why, अपकृतम् offence.

40014439.author: Translation
40014439.content: "What offence did Rama do earlier to the Rakshasa king that he abducted the glorious wife of Rama from Janasthana?"

40014440.author: पदार्थः
40014440.content: अतिवृत्तः acted beyond his limit, खरः Khara, रणे: in war, रामेण: by Rama, हतःयदि has been killed also, प्राणिना: by living beings, यथाबलम् their own strength, प्राणाः life, अवश्यम् certainly, रक्षितव्याः will have to protect.

40014440.author: Translation
40014440.content: "(It is true) Khara was killed by Rama in war as he acted beyond his limit. Certainly, living beings will have to protect their life with their own strength."

40014441.author: पदार्थः
40014441.content: एतन्निमित्तम् on account of this reason, नः to us, सुमहत् great, वैदेहीभयम् fear from Vaidehi, भवेत् will have, आहृता: brought, सा: that, परित्याज्या: given away, कलहार्थे: cause of strife, कृतेन: by doing so, किम् why.

40014441.author: Translation
40014441.content: "On account of this, we have a great fear of Vaidehi. She, who was brought here, is to be given away. What is the use of doing anything, which may be the cause of strife?"

40014442.author: पदार्थः
40014442.content: वीर्यवता: valorous one, धर्मानुवर्तिना: follower of dharma, तेन: his, निरर्थकम् useless, वैरम् enmity, कर्तुम् to have, नतुक्षमम् not good for us, मैथिली: Mythili, अस्य: to him, दीयताम् give away.

40014442.author: Translation
40014442.content: "To have enmity with a valorous one, a follower of dharma, is useless and not good for us. Give away Mythili to him (Rama)."

40014443.author: पदार्थः
40014443.content: सगजाम् with elephants, साश्वम् horses, बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम् filled with many gems, पुरीम् city, बाणैः arrows, यावत् all over, नदारयते: before tearing, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् will give.

40014443.author: Translation
40014443.content: "Before Rama comes with elephants and horses and tears with his arrows, this Lanka filled with abundance of gems, give away Mythili."

40014444.author: पदार्थः
40014444.content: सुघोरा: highly dreadful, दुर्धर्षा: formidable, महती: huge, हरिवाहिनी: Vanara troops, यावत् total, नः lest, लङ्काम् Lanka, नावस्कन्दति: surrounds, तावत् before doing anything, सीता: Sita, प्रदीयताम् give away.

40014444.author: Translation
40014444.content: "Lest the highly dreadful, formidable and huge Vanara troops surround all over Lanka. Give away Sita."

40014445.author: पदार्थः
40014445.content: रामस्य: Rama's, दयिता: dear, स्वयम् his own, पत्नी: wife, नदीयतेयदि: if not given, चलङ्कापुरी: and this Lanka, विनश्येत् हि: will be destroyed, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाश्च: Rakshasas also.

40014445.author: Translation
40014445.content: "If Rama's dear wife is not given, this Lanka will be destroyed and also all Rakshasas."

40014446.author: पदार्थः
40014446.content: बन्धुत्वात् relation, त्वाम् your, प्रसादये: requesting you, मम: my, वचनम् words, कुरुष्य: do as I say, अहम् I, हितम् welfare, तथ्यंतु: for your, ब्रूमि: telling, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् give away.

40014446.author: Translation
40014446.content: "I am requesting you because you are my relation (brother). Do as I said, as I am telling you for your welfare. Give away Sita."

40014447.author: पदार्थः
40014447.content: नृपात्मजः son of emperor, शरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान् shining like the autumnal Sun, नवाग्रपुङ्खान् provided with fresh heads and shafts, सुदृढान् solid, आमोघान् unfailing, विशिखान् arrows, ते for your, वधाय: killing, पुरा: before, सृजति: sends forth, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: son of Dasaratha, प्रदीयताम् you may restore.

40014447.author: Translation
40014447.content: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."

40014448.author: पदार्थः
40014448.content: सुखधर्मनाशनम् happiness will destroy virtues, कोपम् anger, आशु: that, त्यज: give up, रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् pleasures that enhance fame, धर्मम् righteousness, भजस्व: seek, प्रसीद: pacified, सपुत्रबान्धवाः with sons and relatives, जीवेम: live, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: Dasaratha's son Rama's, प्रदीयताम् restore.

40014448.author: Translation
40014448.content: "Give up that happiness and anger which destroys virtues. Seek pleasures that enhance fame. Be pacified. Live happily with sons and relatives restoring Mythili to Rama, the son of Dasaratha."

40014449.author: पदार्थः
40014449.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, तान् those, सर्वान् everything, विसर्जयित्वा: sending away स्वकम् he too, गृहम् home, प्रविवेश: entered.

40014449.author: Translation
40014449.content: Having heard everything that was told by Vibheeshana, the Lord of Rakshasas sent away all and entered his palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेनवमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
